Other vegetables: 531 × 0.11 × 2 × 0.6 ≈70 g. Chicken: 531 × 0.07 × 1.5 × 0.95 ≈53 g. Dressing is estimated at 12 g; coffee at 170 g.

**STEP 7 – Energy:** Estimated using typical cooked-food values: sushi 150, wrapped rolls 150, leaves 20, vegetables 35, chicken 165, dressing 450, and coffee 25 kcal per 100 g.

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The estimate is about 593 g including coffee, with the salad and rolls making up most of the food. This seems plausible for the visible portions.
